simple.meaning: טוֹב (ṭôwb) is a Hebrew concept word meaning “good (as an adjective) in the widest sense; used likewise as a noun, both in the masculine and the feminine, the singular and the plural (good, a good or good thing, a good man or woman; the good, goods or good things, good men or women), also as an adverb (well).” BibleIQ follows how Scripture develops this idea across its occurrences.
simple.biblicalBackground: The concept appears 565 times across Genesis, Exodus, Leviticus, Numbers, Deuteronomy, and 2 more, beginning at Genesis 1:4. Its contexts include land.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to טוֹב (H2896).
simple.whyItMatters: Concept words shape biblical themes. BibleIQ keeps the concept grounded in actual verse evidence instead of starting with a later theological definition.
simple.summary: טוֹב (ṭôwb) / H2896 is traced through Genesis 1:4, Genesis 1:10, Genesis 1:12, Genesis 1:18 as a generated source-based concept entry.
